brief.scope: Work order: the uncited-correction gate. The requirements are the ten numbered Contract items of .dev/ladder-inputs/scope-gate-20260910.md, tracked in this snapshot at the ref; read it and .dev/ladder-inputs/scope-discipline.md WHOLE from the snapshot tree. Nothing else is a requirement. Refuse at mint any write job that answers reviewer findings unless every finding it answers is named by key, disposed in the findings ledger, and the disposition cites the numbered contract item it violates; the ladder stops before its fix stages instead of correcting. No override. Boundaries as listed there; do not widen them.

findings.claim: Contract item 3 requires the needed half to name the exact findings.py disposition command that would satisfy the refusal; item 4 requires evidence to contain `contract item N` and to name that scope file by path. The declared grammar `contract item (?P<item>[1-9][0-9]*) of (?P<path>[^\s;,]+)` (plan D3, quoted in CONTRACT.md, pinned once by test_launch_correction_contract.py) together with the prescribed evidence `contract item N of <scope path>: <why>` (CONTRACT.md correction row; plan D3 example and D5 needed command) captures the trailing colon inside `path`, so the planned citation_holds file check cannot resolve the scope file. Following the printed remedy therefore stays uncited, and item 6 gives no override.
findings.reproduce: python3 -c "import re; from pathlib import Path; p=re.compile(r'contract item (?P<item>[1-9][0-9]*) of (?P<path>[^\\s;,]+)'); ev='contract item 3 of .dev/ladder-inputs/scope-gate-20260910.md: found-text missing'; m=p.search(ev); print(m['path']); assert m['path'].endswith(':') and not Path(m['path']).is_file() and Path('.dev/ladder-inputs/scope-gate-20260910.md').is_file()"

findings.claim: Contract item 7: a write job that follows a plan, tests, or implement record, or follows nothing, is not a correction and is not inspected by this gate. Plan D7 inspects that job when `--answers` is present and refuses class arguments.
findings.reproduce: python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; t=Path('.dev/ladder-inputs/plan-gate-contracts.md').read_text(); s=Path('.dev/ladder-inputs/scope-gate-20260910.md').read_text(); print([ln.strip() for ln in t.splitlines() if 'not a correction is refused' in ln][0]); assert 'is not inspected by this gate' in s and 'on a write job that is not a correction is refused' in t"
